about: The approved palette (docs/art-style-bible.md section 1, decision 1, 2026-10-23). Each ramp runs dark to light. The brass highlight #e2c27a and the fire ramp are confirmed on the first chassis's review sheet; if the user marks them there, they change here and in the bible before the second chassis. Read by Tools/Art/art_metrics.Palette.

outline.note: warm brown, never black; the carts' outline

mahogany.note: red-brown wood, the carts after softening

fire.note: fireboxes, the hearth, the Overclocker's glow; confirmed on the first chassis

skin.note: the Artificer's face and hands (S1b), today's tones

leather.note: the Artificer's oxblood apron, strap and boots (S1b); under the reserved red's saturation

cloth.note: the Artificer's sage shirt, eyes and goggle lenses (S1b); not malachite (invariant 6)

slate.note: the Artificer's trousers (S1b); off the reserved steel blue's hue
